_source: Owner/CoS-maintained by hand — NOT harvested by scripts/registry-build.ts. The system of record for cloud routines is claude.ai (Code Routines), not this repo, so there is no manifest to harvest from. Edit this file directly whenever a routine is created, rescheduled, or retired in claude.ai, and bump `updated`. `registry:check` never rewrites or drops this file — the harvester (scripts/registry-build.ts) does not reference `routines.json` at all.
note: Lists only TIME-SCHEDULED cloud routines — the recurring cron-fired runners created in claude.ai that clone this repo and open PRs. EVENT-DRIVEN loops (fired by triggers inside a session, not a wall clock — e.g. `dev-cycle`, `ticket-cycle`, `decision`, `level-set`, `request-intake`, `new-app`, `heal`, `core-upgrade`) have no routine and so have no entry here; see registry/loops.json for the full loop set. For each routine below, this file is memory + a link target ([[adr-016]] zero-Claude-call rule) — it does not imply in-app control. The LIVE (self-tuned) cadence and run history are NOT duplicated here: read the named loop's most recent [[ledger]] `cadence-decision` block (`ran_at`, `trigger`, `next_cadence_days`, `reason`) — see the loop's own manifest for the protocol.

routines.name: Request triage
routines.note: PAUSED 2026-09-22 pending [[work-115]] — console test helpers leaked ~200 verbatim test fixtures into the shared Turso store (SCOPE_CREEP_DB_URL precedence shadowed the vitest :memory: pin), which the hourly sweep re-triaged, flooding the Console. Leak-fix proposed in scope-creep-console#74 (test-db isolation + fail-closed guard + defensive fixture denylist). Un-pause is Owner-gated on: (a) #74 merged, (b) Owner runs docs/owner-cleanup-work-115-fixture-threads.md (read-only count first, then archive) and confirms the store is clean. This entry was previously stale-'active' while the routine was actually paused — corrected to reality. HOURLY (:17) — the loop that closes the Request Loop ([[prd-request-loop]]). Runs in the custom cloud env 'scope-creep-local' (holds DATABASE_URL + DATABASE_AUTH_TOKEN, *.turso.io allowlisted) and clones scope-creep-console as a sibling for the triage CLI + shared thread store ([[adr-025]]). Runtime is Node (npm run triage), not bun (egress proxy drops bun's fetch). Cadence self-tunes per [[work-067]].
